narrative.overview: Minimal, bespoke, intuitive native macOS Photo Workbench, refreshed as a quiet photo canvas. One search row leads a full-proportion recycled AppKit masonry gallery; native filters and supporting panes appear when useful. Source/local checks and native wide/light compact/dark QA passed. Reviewer disposition is ship at the two-fix-list scope after confirming corrected blocked-query state and documentation. This does not imply whole-surface, general performance or accessibility signoff.
keyCharacteristics: Photograph-led neutral surroundings and full proportions
Familiar native interaction with optional panes
Single search row and on-demand refinement
Readable constraints, availability, coverage and provenance

rules.name: The Photograph Rule
rules.body: Keep decorative color out of the image canvas; actual photographs carry the palette.

rules.name: The State Rule
rules.body: Color supplements meaningful state and is never its sole explanation.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: Core actions have readable labels; icons support meaning.

rules.name: The Stable Place Rule
rules.body: Keep primary controls consistent and preserve meaningful selection through organization changes where possible.

dos: Do preserve full photograph proportions and neutral surroundings.
Do use native macOS controls and system appearance.
Do expose individual constraints and incomplete coverage.
Do distinguish focus, selection, availability and provenance.
donts: Don't add gallery captions, card framing or decorative overlays.
Don't equate palette families with object detection.
Don't invent fixed native color, radius or SF metrics.
Don't claim revised visual or accessibility signoff from compilation or old captures.
